description: Offline k6 load, HTTP and TLS analysis. Layout inspired by Grafana dashboards 16803 and 2587; native Flux queries for k6_raw.

panels.title: Run configuration
panels.description: Saved benchmark settings and runtime evidence, one row per execution. Run shows stack and UTC run timestamp; Load is scheduled iterations or configured requests/s (peak for ramped profiles). OS, TLS runtime/version, and Server GC are observed from the live server metadata; OSSource records the runtime evidence source. ImageBase is build-declared provenance, not proof of the observed OS. Missing OS evidence is never inferred from images or current deployments. Resume means configured TLS resumption, not proof of resumed handshakes. IIS/.NET Framework reports non-containerized base provenance. Full run and execution IDs remain available through Inspect > Data with transformations disabled. Legacy summaries remain visible with '-' for unavailable configuration. Runs without any summary points are not included. runName is the authored friendly name; Execution is the unique 1-based index within the expanded run.

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.wtt_run_id =~ /^${wtt_run_id:regex}$/ and r.wtt_scenario =~ /^${wtt_scenario:regex}$/ and r.wtt_stack =~ /^${wtt_stack:regex}$/ and r.wtt_profile =~ /^${wtt_profile:regex}$/ and r.warmup == "false")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with wtt_execution_index: if exists r.wtt_execution_index then r.wtt_execution_index else ""}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.wtt_execution_index =~ /^${wtt_execution_index:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with wtt_run_name: if exists r.wtt_run_name then r.wtt_run_name else "-"}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r._field, set: ["elapsed_ms", "data_sent_bytes", "data_received_bytes", "tls_terminated_at", "tls_version", "key_exchange_group", "tls_resumption_configured", "http_version", "connection_reuse", "configured_vus", "configured_iterations", "max_duration_s", "payload_bytes", "endpoint", "client_source_ips", "configured_rate", "configured_peak_rate", "image_reference", "image_digest", "server_os", "server_os_source", "server_runtime_version", "server_upstream_runtime_image", "server_upstream_runtime_digest", "server_tls_runtime", "server_tls_runtime_version", "server_gc"]))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "wtt_run_id", "wtt_scenario", "wtt_stack", "wtt_profile", "cell", "wtt_execution_index", "wtt_run_name"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.key_exchange_group =~ /^${wtt_tls_group_verified:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["wtt_run_id", "wtt_scenario", "wtt_stack", "wtt_profile", "cell", "tls_terminated_at", "tls_version", "key_exchange_group", "tls_resumption_configured", "http_version", "connection_reuse", "configured_vus", "configured_iterations", "max_duration_s", "payload_bytes", "endpoint", "client_source_ips", "configured_rate", "configured_peak_rate", "image_reference", "image_digest", "server_os", "server_os_source", "server_runtime_version", "server_upstream_runtime_image", "server_upstream_runtime_digest", "server_tls_runtime", "server_tls_runtime_version", "server_gc", "wtt_execution_index", "wtt_run_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with

      else if exists r.configured_rate then string(v: r.configured_rate) + "/s"
      else "-",
    VUs: if exists r.configured_vus then string(v: r.configured_vus) else "-",
    Limit: if exists r.max_duration_s then string(v: r.max_duration_s) + " s" else "-",
    Payload: if exists r.payload_bytes then string(v: r.payload_bytes) + " B" else "-",
    HTTP: if exists r.http_version then r.http_version else "-",
    TLS: if exists r.tls_version then r.tls_version else "-",
    TLSGroup: if exists r.key_exchange_group then r.key_exchange_group else "-",
    Resume: if exists r.tls_resumption_configured then (if r.tls_resumption_configured then "On" else "Off") else "-",
    Reuse: if exists r.connection_reuse then (if r.connection_reuse then "On" else "Off") else "-",
    Image: if exists r.image_reference then r.image_reference else "-",
    Digest: if exists r.image_digest then r.image_digest else "-",
    OS: if exists r.server_os then r.server_os else "-",
    OSSource: if exists r.server_os_source then r.server_os_source else "unrecorded",
    Runtime: if exists r.server_runtime_version then r.server_runtime_version else "-",
    ImageBase: if exists r.server_upstream_runtime_image then r.server_upstream_runtime_image + (if exists r.server_upstream_runtime_digest then "@" + r.server_upstream_runtime_digest else "") else "-",
    TLSlib: if exists r.server_tls_runtime then r.server_tls_runtime else "-",
    TLSlibver: if exists r.server_tls_runtime_version then r.server_tls_runtime_version else "-",
    ServerGC: if exists r.server_gc then (if r.server_gc then "On" else "Off") else "-"
  }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["wtt_run_id", "cell", "wtt_execution_index", "wtt_run_name"])

panels.description: One bar per selected Run ID | Scenario | Stack | Profile | TLS version | TLS resumption. Computed from raw observations, not averages of windowed percentiles. Outcomes are separate by recorded HTTP status; 0 means no HTTP response, not a server status.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k6_raw" and r._field == "value" and r.metric == "http_req_duration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.wtt_run_id =~ /^${wtt_run_id:regex}$/ and r.wtt_scenario =~ /^${wtt_scenario:regex}$/ and r.wtt_stack =~ /^${wtt_stack:regex}$/ and r.wtt_profile =~ /^${wtt_profile:regex}$/ and r.wtt_execution_index =~ /^${wtt_execution_index:regex}$/ and r.wtt_tls_group_verified =~ /^${wtt_tls_group_verified:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with wtt_execution_index: if exists r.wtt_execution_index then r.wtt_execution_index else ""}))
  |> group(columns: ["wtt_run_id", "wtt_scenario", "wtt_stack", "wtt_profile", "wtt_execution_index"])
  |> quantile(q: 0.01, method: "estimate_tdigest")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({statistic: "value", series: r.wtt_run_id + " | " + r.wtt_scenario + " | " + r.wtt_stack + " | " + (r.wtt_profile + (if r.wtt_execution_index == "" then "" else "-" + r.wtt_execution_index)), _value: r._value}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["statistic"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")

panels.description: ${timing_stat} of raw k6 observations in each selected Chart window, using the same readable time-series form as the request-rate chart. What it measures: complete HTTP request/response time after a usable connection is available. Starts when k6 begins sending the HTTP request and ends when the complete response body is received. HTTP duration = sending + waiting + receiving; it excludes DNS lookup, TCP connection establishment, TLS handshaking, and blocked time. Outcomes are separate by recorded HTTP status; 0 means no HTTP response, not a server status.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k6_raw" and r._field == "value" and r.metric == "http_req_duration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.wtt_run_id =~ /^${wtt_run_id:regex}$/ and r.wtt_scenario =~ /^${wtt_scenario:regex}$/ and r.wtt_stack =~ /^${wtt_stack:regex}$/ and r.wtt_profile =~ /^${wtt_profile:regex}$/ and r.wtt_execution_index =~ /^${wtt_execution_index:regex}$/ and r.wtt_tls_group_verified =~ /^${wtt_tls_group_verified:regex}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with wtt_execution_index: if exists r.wtt_execution_index then r.wtt_execution_index else ""}))
  |> keep(columns: ["wtt_run_id", "wtt_scenario", "wtt_stack", "wtt_profile", "_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "wtt_execution_index"])
  |> group(columns: ["wtt_run_id", "wtt_scenario", "wtt_stack", "wtt_profile", "wtt_execution_index"])

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, series: "${timing_stat} | " + r.wtt_run_id + " | " + r.wtt_scenario + " | " + r.wtt_stack + " | " + (r.wtt_profile + (if r.wtt_execution_index == "" then "" else "-" + r.wtt_execution_index))}))

  |> group(columns: ["wtt_run_id", "wtt_scenario", "wtt_stack", "wtt_profile", "wtt_execution_index"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${resolution:raw}, fn: if "${timing_stat}" == "Mean" then mean else if "${timing_stat}" == "P90" then (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.9, column: column, method: "estimate_tdigest") else if "${timing_stat}" == "P95" then (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: column, method: "estimate_tdigest") else if "${timing_stat}" == "P99" then (column, tables=<-) => tables |> quantile(q: 0.99, column: column, method: "estimate_tdigest") else max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, series: "${timing_stat} | " + r.wtt_run_id + " | " + r.wtt_scenario + " | " + r.wtt_stack + " | " + (r.wtt_profile + (if r.wtt_execution_index == "" then "" else "-" + r.wtt_execution_index))}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with wtt_execution_index: if exists r.wtt_execution_index then r.wtt_execution_index else ""}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 0.0)
  |> keep(columns: ["wtt_run_id", "wtt_scenario", "wtt_stack", "wtt_profile", "_value", "wtt_execution_index"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with bucket: if r._value < 0.01 then "00: 0-0.01" else if r._value < 0.05 then "01: 0.01-0.05" else if r._value < 0.1 then "02: 0.05-0.1" else if r._value < 0.25 then "03: 0.1-0.25" else if r._value < 0.5 then "04: 0.25-0.5" else if r._value < 1.0 then "05: 0.5-1" else if r._value < 2.0 then "06: 1-2" else if r._value < 5.0 then "07: 2-5" else if r._value < 10.0 then "08: 5-10" else if r._value < 25.0 then "09: 10-25" else if r._value < 50.0 then "10: 25-50" else if r._value < 100.0 then "11: 50-100" else if r._value < 250.0 then "12: 100-250" else if r._value < 500.0 then "13: 250-500" else if r._value < 1000.0 then "14: 500-1000" else "15: >=1000"}))
  |> group(columns: ["wtt_run_id", "wtt_scenario", "wtt_stack", "wtt_profile", "bucket", "wtt_execution_index"])
  |> count()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({bucket: r.bucket, series: r.wtt_run_id + " | " + r.wtt_scenario + " | " + r.wtt_stack + " | " + (r.wtt_profile + (if r.wtt_execution_index == "" then "" else "-" + r.wtt_execution_index)), _value: r._value}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["bucket"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["bucket"])
  |> rename(columns: {bucket: "Duration (ms)"})
